A.question: Does an actual SIGKILL of a process inside the exact secure_store.append_private_jsonl implementation leave a parseable/incomplete row and will exact private_audit and CLI fail closed?
A.estimand: Positive detection of unsafe incomplete journal after crash, not recovery
A.acceptance: 2 strictly synthetic cases: previously empty and one valid prior line. Child patches only write adapter to emit real partial os.write then blocks, parent SIGKILL. Check -9, no terminating newline, native audit ValueError INCOMPLETE_LEDGER_RECORD and CLI exit2.

rivals: Caught OSError rollback handles SIGKILL (it cannot)
SIGKILL before bytes flush leaves no detectable row (invalid case)

C: Run true subprocess native exact source using stdout signal to prove half-write occurred, SIGKILL just child, read ledger and run original auditor+CLI.

D.falsifier: Any audit returns exit0 or full row accepted; source blob identity must match GitHub.
D.limit: Power loss not simulated, no real originals.
